measurement.method: Fixed offline Intake, Planner, Worker, and Verifier fakes at commit 3ba9fd3eb3ad84b193f699e72e15bc40bea40446. Prompt characters are deterministic proxies. Mock completion characters use one canonical JSON serialization of each complete emitted fake response, including structured tool_calls.
measurement.measurement_definition_correction: The original Task 1 artifact counted only response.content and called a duplicate request blocked before tool execution a duplicate retrieval. These values were re-derived from the original commit and immutable fixtures: full emitted responses are now counted, requests and guard rejections are distinct from actual retrieval executions. This is a measurement-definition correction, not a retroactive performance estimate.

scenarios.A: One Worker generation with no tool request.
scenarios.B: Planner query 聚乙烯 质量异常 排查 建议 常见异常, successful prefetch evidence, then a repeated first adaptive request.

optimized.method: The same fixed offline fixtures after claim grounding, Worker prefetch reuse, compact Verifier output, and Intake/Planner prompt compression. Prompt and full-response character counts are deterministic proxies, not provider tokens.

verifier_pass_comparison.method: Run tests/measure_verifier_snapshot.py against a git archive of the exact baseline commit, then run the same state and fake PASS response against current production code. No legacy prompt builder is copied into tests.
